scripts.gen:types: supabase gen types --lang typescript --schema public > packages/shared/src/database.types.ts && prettier --write packages/shared/src/database.types.ts
scripts.functions:check: for f in supabase/functions/*/index.ts; do deno check --config "$(dirname $f)/deno.json" "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.functions:test: for d in supabase/functions/*/; do [ -f "$d/deno.json" ] && { deno test --allow-env --config "$d/deno.json" "$d" || exit 1; }; done; true
